## GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored API

GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored is a large language model by Z.ai, available on the Venice API as `glm-5-3-flash-uncensored`. This model is private and no prompt data is stored in any capacity.

GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored is an abliterated, uncensored variant of GLM-5.3 Flash, a reasoning model designed for coding, sustained agentic work, and production workloads, with a 1M-token context window. It natively processes images and text, with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic performance and no content-filtering guardrails.

### GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `glm-5-3-flash-uncensored` | Standard | Private | $0.165 / $0.55 per 1M |

### How to use the GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "glm-5-3-flash-uncensored"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "glm-5-3-flash-uncensored",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "high"
  }'
```
